reading: Rolled chords all through the piece: every chord that is spread out in time becomes an ornament with a <temporalSpread> fitted to how it was rolled, and is taken as one onset from here on.

Each half bar of bars 1 to 8 gets its own steady tempo, read off where its first chord and the next half bar's were played; where a half bar begins on a held note, the tempo runs on to the next onset.
